title: Complete the krn/gate check when a build fails before the gate
body:
Outcome: a Jenkins build that fails before the gate (executor/session stage) completes its GitHub `krn/gate` check run as failure. Main #97 (141ce49) ended FAILURE while check run 127889270747 stayed in_progress, so deliver and krn ci wait cannot see the red result.
Proof: a failing pre-gate stage produces a completed check run with conclusion failure and the stage in its summary.
